title: Prefix Sum
definition: Prefix sum is a technique where cumulative sums of elements are precomputed.
intuition: Allows O(1) range sum queries by calculating prefix sums beforehand.
how_it_works: P[i] = P[i-1] + A[i]. Range sum of [L, R] = P[R] - P[L-1].
when_to_use: Frequent range sum or count queries on static arrays.
when_not_to_use: When arrays undergo frequent dynamic updates (use Segment Trees).
content: Prefix sum is a technique where cumulative sums of elements are precomputed.
